description:
Watch Dr. Robert Malone's full testimony explaining what has been learned about the synthetic mRNA and lipid nanoparticle technology in the Covid vaccines. Most importantly, the mRNA and its lipid casing does not stay in the shoulder and then dissolve quickly after triggering an immune response, as the public was told. Instead, this material travels all throughout the body and continues making spike proteins in distant tissues for 60 days or more -- and, Malone warns, “the [mRNA and lipid nanoparticle] technology is inflammatory, which is a big word for saying it’s toxic.”Show more Sen. Ron Johnson Roundtable Discussion: Covid-19 Vaccines: What They Are, How They Work and Possible Causes of Injuries. December 7, 2022
